Name: Genshin Impact Plushies - Mondstadt
Author: vikich3rry
Description:
Ever wanted to go through the process of turning over-detailed designs into 16x16 sprites? No? Well I did, because I had nothing better to do [s]during boring classes[/s] in my free time. Aaand I really wanted a Razor plushie. So now you get to have plushies of your favorite Mondstadters!
[line]
[b][i][color=#a2c4c9][size=3]Features[/size][/color][/i][/b]
🪽 All [b]24 playable characters from Mondstadt[/b] [size=1](as of Luna VIII)[/size], added as [b]new furniture[/b] placeable both indoors and outdoors
🍷 [b]Characters included, in order of release:[/b] Venti, Diluc, Jean, Mona, Kaeya, Lisa, Amber, Barbara, Noelle, Sucrose, Razor, Bennett, Fischl, Diona, Klee, Albedo, Rosaria, Eula, Mika, Dahlia, Durin, Varka, Prune and Lohen
🪽 Easily find them in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39884]Genshin Plushies Catalogue[/url]﻿!
🍷 If you don't have my catalogue, they'll be in the [b]Furniture Catalogue[/b] [size=1](search for 'Genshin' or 'Mondstadt' if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url])[/size]
🪽 Consolation for when you want a character but the gacha isn't kind to you - at least you can have them in a different game!
🍷 [b]i18n compatible![/b] Includes English and Spanish as of 1.0.0
[line]
[b][i][color=#a2c4c9][size=3]Future Plans[/size][/color][/i][/b]
🪽 This will be updated for as long as I'm still into both Stardew and Genshin [size=1](aka a very, [i]very[/i] long time, because I've invested way too much on both to let go)[/size], so [b]new characters will be added as they're released![/b]
🍷 [b]Continuing the series![/b]
   ✧ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38334]Mondstadt[/url] - you're here!
   ✧ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39263]Liyue[/url]

   ✧ ﻿Natlan
   ﻿✧ Nod-Krai
   ✧ ﻿Other Factions [size=1](Harbingers, Mages and the Twins will be here!)[/size]

[line]

Also! If you're still here because you're as obsessed as me with this silly game, I highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35360]Botany of Teyvat[/url]! You've probably already seen it if you're downloading this, but if you haven't then go get it right now! Don't you want to have Venti overseeing your Cecilias? Make a little forest area in your farm with Wolfhook bushes and have Razor in there? Because I sure do. [i]And I will[/i].
[line]
[color=#d0e0e3][size=2]Fun Fact: Playing Genshin since 1.4 means that 4 years later I'm still a proud Razor main - do I have a c1 Skirk with c1 Furina, Shenhe, and Escoffier? Yes. Am I still gonna use my best boy Razor because he's triple crowned and has a 5 star claymore r2? Of course.
It also means I've had all Mondstadt 5 stars for years now, so please Hoyoverse I'm [i]begging[/i] you to release Durin and Alice already-

December 3rd update: I GOT DURIN AND VENTI'S BOW !!! Also my beloved Razor was buffed I'm so happy <3[/size][/color]
[color=#d0e0e3][size=2]June update: Got Lohen, his polearm and Mavuika's claymore in only 60 pulls and no pity/guaranteeds! Hope everyone got who they wanted too ^^[/size][/color]
[line]
